title: Event Card
description: One decision card. Historical facts are fixed; only consequences branch on player choice.

id.description: Stable kebab-case key. Never reused, never renumbered.

order.description: Chronological slot within the dynasty. Must be consistent with `year`.

year.description: Gregorian year of the underlying real event. null ONLY when historicity = invented.

historicity.description: Maps 1:1 onto the three buckets Report section 2 must declare: authentic / simplified for gameplay / creative reinterpretation.

sources.description: At least one source per card. Cards with historicity=invented still need the source for the surrounding context they sit in.

tags.description: Free labels for the How-To-Play search/filter requirement, e.g. military, diplomacy, court.

appearsIf.description: Gate. Omit for cards always eligible.

oneShot.description: false only for generic pressure cards that may repeat.

historicalNote.description: What actually happened. Shown after EITHER choice, unchanged. This is the accuracy guarantee: the player's counterfactual never overwrites the record.

type.description: encyclopedia (e.g. Wikipedia) is a starting point for finding sources, not an acceptable sole citation for the report.

verifiedBy.description: Team member who checked this against the source.

effects.description: Stat deltas, keyed by statId declared in the dynasty file.

grants.description: Preparation flags set by this choice.

outcome.description: In-game consequence of THIS choice. May be counterfactual.
